tips.title: Set default metric configuration
tips.body: Select Settings, Configuration from Mastercam's menu and choose ...\mcamxm.config <Metric> from the Current drop-down list.

tips.title: Use AutoCursor for quick selection
tips.body: Move cursor to the center of the graphics window where the X and Y axes cross to select the origin.

tips.title: Lock line length for multiple lines
tips.body: Click the Length button on the Line ribbon bar to lock the value, which is useful when creating multiple lines with the same length.

tips.title: Draw horizontal lines using Horizontal button
tips.body: Click the Horizontal button on the Line ribbon bar to ensure the next line drawn will be horizontal.

tips.title: Create parallel lines using Create Line Parallel function
tips.body: Select the first line and use the Create Line Parallel function to draw a parallel line.

tips.title: Draw circles using Create Circle Edge Point function
tips.body: Select two points and use the Create Circle Edge Point function to draw a circle.

tips.title: Use FastPoint mode for precise circle drawing
tips.body: Enter coordinates directly in the FastPoint field without coordinate letters.

tips.title: Select entities using chaining for offset contour
tips.body: Use the Xform Offset Contour function and select entities linked by adjoining endpoints.

tips.title: Trim geometry using the Trim/Break function
tips.body: Select entities and locations to trim using Edit, Trim/Break, Trim/Break/Extend.

tips.title: Mirror geometry using General Selection
tips.body: Select the area to mirror and use Xform, Mirror from the menu.

tips.title: Use relative positioning for additional holes
tips.body: Hold down the [Shift] key and click existing points to position new points relative to them.
